notes: Correction: the second *that* (t010) is no longer `added`. It is the written `כִּי` rewritten at the head of the second coordinated complement clause, which rule 55 assigns to that morpheme's discontinuous unit while the waw keeps only its *And*.

A competing reading takes *no* as a supplied determiner on `מְזִמָּה` with `לֹא` fused into *no purpose*; the reading retained follows rule 15, which gives such a determiner to the negative morpheme the recasting turns into it.
